entries.authority_limit: This entry proves the exact authenticated source-note claim that the P2 was materially changed on the final PR head and that an exact-head Codex re-review then reported no remaining major issues. It does not elevate owner prose or the clean Codex result into universal semantic-correctness authority.

rules: the original finding must bind an exact Codex review and inline comment on the authenticated reviewed head
the fixed head must be the live final PR head, descend from the reviewed head, and remain on canonical default-branch ancestry
the owner reply must be the exact reply to the original finding and must bind the declared fixed head in its body
the re-review request must be owner-authored and name the full declared fixed head
the clean Codex result must be the exact bot/App-authored issue comment, follow the re-review request, and bind its Reviewed commit prefix to the declared fixed head
the clean result must remain the final Codex-authored review evidence on that PR
immutable fixed-head content must support the material change claimed by the source note
a clean re-review is evidence about that exact review run, not universal proof of semantic correctness
